purpose: test-only bootstrap for isolated forward migration replay; not historical migration source
capture_method: Supabase CLI db dump; schema-only; no rows or custom roles
notes: This is a snapshot of the observed live schema at the recorded migration-ledger checkpoint, not a reconstruction of historical DDL.

Review object definitions, policies, grants, SECURITY DEFINER functions, and the manifest before changing review_status.

This status is approved only on the isolated replay test branch after static checks; it does not approve production deployment, migration application to production, or merging this baseline artifact.
